# proton-pass-cli

Retrieve a stored credential (an API key, a gateway token, a password, an SSH key) from Proton Pass with the pass-cli tool, authenticating with a Personal Access Token held in the OS keyring. Use whenever a task needs a secret that lives in Proton Pass, before starting any tool or service that reads such a secret, or to log in somewhere with a stored password. Covers session bootstrap, authenticated reads with a mandatory access reason, and auto-recovery from an expired session.

Ships in the [`proton`](../../README.md) plugin of [Uraxii/dotai](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai). The agent reads [SKILL.md](SKILL.md); this file is for people.

## Requirements

Needs the pass-cli tool and a Proton Pass personal access token in the OS keyring.

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install proton@Uraxii
```

Codex CLI:

```
codex plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai --ref main
codex plugin add proton@uraxii
```

Copilot CLI:

```
copilot plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
copilot plugin install proton@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
